description: This PHP source file defines the OptionalFieldAPI class within the OrangeHRM project, which provides API endpoints for retrieving and updating optional configuration fields related to the HRM system's PIM module. It includes methods for getting current configuration, validating requests, saving updates, and associated OpenAPI documentation annotations.

classes.name: OptionalFieldAPI
classes.description: API controller for managing optional fields configuration in the PIM module of OrangeHRM, including retrieval and updating of settings such as SSN, SIN, and tax exemptions.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve current optional field configurations as an array of boolean flags.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update optional field configuration settings based on request payload.

methods.name: saveOptionalFields
methods.description: Persists the optional configuration parameters received in the request to the configuration service and returns the updated parameters array.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the getOne API request.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the update API request, ensuring boolean values for the configuration fields.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; attempts to delete will throw an exception.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented; attempts to validate delete requests will raise an exception.
